channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: BBC apologises after not editing out racial slur heard during BAFTAs
item.description: The BBC is under fire for not editing out a racial slur shouted by a man with Tourette's syndrome from its broadcast of last night's Baftas.

item.title: Story of Malawian boy who saved flooded village hits stage
item.description: A Malawian boy who saved his village from floods and drought by building a windmill has already inspired a book, a film and a Ted Talk.

item.title: Epstein files: Parliament debates Andrew allegations
item.description: Lord Mandelson has said his arrest was prompted by a "baseless suggestion" he was preparing to leave the UK and move abroad.

item.title: Mandelson arrest shows ‘powerful and privileged’ face same justice system, says Health Secretary
item.description: The controversies in the Epstein files have continued to dominate Westminster, but the government is also under the spotlight over the organisation Labour Together, which helped Sir Keir Starmer become party leader.

item.title: Molly Russell’s friends call social media firms ‘heartless’
item.description: Molly Russell, a fourteen-year-old from North London, took her own life after being exposed to a stream of harmful content online in 2017.

item.title: Ukraine marks grim fourth anniversary of full scale Russia invasion
item.description: Silence fell across Ukraine today as people gathered around the country to mark four years since Russia's full-scale invasion.

item.title: ‘Instead of talking we should act’ on Ukraine says former Nato boss
item.description: We spoke to former Nato Secretary General and Danish Prime Minister Anders Fogh Rasmussen if he agrees with President Zelenskyy's warning that World War Three is already underway, and that European leaders haven't caught up with the danger yet.

item.title: Trump prepares to deliver State of the Union address
item.description: Donald Trump speaks to Congress on Tuesday night in his annual State of the Union address to set out his presidential agenda for the next year.

item.title: Lyon: Killing of far-right student rocks French politics
item.description: The killing of far-right student, Quentin Deranque, by suspected far-left activists in Lyon has had reverberations across French politics and in Washington with President Trump weighing in over the killing.

item.title: Plan to scrap many jury trials in England and Wales despite criticism
item.description: The government has set out its plan to reduce the backlog of court cases, which stands at some 80,000 criminal cases.
